home.nothingDue: Today's review is done. See you tomorrow.
home.guestBody: You can start learning without signing in — your progress is kept on this phone.
home.cardHint: Tap the card to turn it
home.greetingNote: "Ahlan wa sahlan", the old Arabic greeting, meaning: "you have arrived among your own family, and may your path be easy."
home.headline: <brand>Mufradat</brand> is the straightforward way for Bengali speakers to learn Arabic vocabulary.
home.decksBody: Each deck is its own world — the words of the Quran, the words of the market, the names for family. Start with whichever you need.
home.closingHeading: Give it ten minutes today. Tomorrow the verse reads a little further.

games.title: Games
games.intro: Each game runs for about a minute and is built from the words you're due today — so playing counts as studying.
games.matchPairsShort: Match each Arabic word to its Bengali meaning
games.multipleChoiceShort: Choose the right meaning from four
games.listeningShort: Hear it, then pick the word
games.streakRushShort: As many as you can before time runs out
games.roundSummary: Score {score, number} · right first time {correct, number}/{total, number}
games.countsAsStudy: These answers counted towards today's review.
games.saveFailed: Couldn't send that answer. It's saved on this phone.
games.notEnoughWordsTitle: Not enough words for a game yet
games.notEnoughWordsBody: Learn a few words first and the games open up.

matchPairsGame.howTo: Tap an Arabic word, then its Bengali meaning. Matched pairs drop out of the board.

multipleChoiceGame.howTo: Read the Arabic word and pick the right meaning from four. A wrong tap lets you try again.

spellingGame.howTo: Read the Bengali meaning and write the Arabic word. Full marks with the vowel marks; right consonants still count.
spellingGame.guideIntro: Type in Latin letters and they turn into Arabic: kitaab gives كتاب.

harakatGame.howTo: The word appears without its vowel marks. Tap a letter, then choose its mark. Letters that carry nothing get “no mark”.
harakatGame.hint: Tap a letter, then place its mark
harakatGame.wrongCount: {count, number} letters don't match — have another look at those

streakRushGame.howTo: Sixty seconds, three options, no second chances. Keep a run going and each answer is worth more than the last.

legal.contactBody: For any question, a correction to a word's meaning, or a request to delete your data, email:
legal.privacyAccountBody: Google gives this app three things only: your name, your email address and your profile picture. Nothing more is requested, and the app has no access to anything else in your Google account.
legal.privacyAccountHeading: If you sign in with Google
legal.privacyCookiesBody: Two cookies are used: one keeps you signed in, the other remembers whether you want Bengali or English. There are no advertising or tracking cookies.
legal.privacyDeleteBody: Email the address below and your account, along with every piece of learning data attached to it, will be deleted. If you have been using the app without signing in, clearing your browser's site data removes everything.
legal.privacyGuestBody: If you learn without an account, all of your progress stays in your own browser — which words you have studied and when, your notes, your game results, everything. None of it is sent anywhere. The only things fetched from the server are the word list and the pronunciation files.
legal.privacyIntro: Mufradat is a free learning app. This page says plainly what is kept, where it is kept, and why.
legal.privacyLearningBody: While signed in, what is stored is: which words you reviewed and when, how you graded yourself, your notes, your game results, your daily streak and your preferences. It exists to be shown back to you — it is never sold and never shared.
legal.privacyThirdPartyBody: The app runs on Vercel, the data is stored in a Neon database (Singapore region), and Google handles sign-in. Your data goes to no one beyond those three.
legal.privacyTrackingBody: No analytics, no advertising, no trackers, no third-party scripts. Your data is never sold.
legal.termsAccountsBody: Signing in is optional. If you do, it is through a Google account, and keeping that account secure is your own responsibility.
legal.termsAccuracyBody: The glosses and explanations here are a learning aid, not a religious authority and not a substitute for tafsir. Mistakes are possible. For a settled understanding of the Qur'an's meaning, consult reliable tafsir and a qualified scholar.
legal.termsAvailabilityBody: This is a personal, free project, offered “as is” with no warranty. The service may be interrupted or may change.
legal.termsChangesBody: If these terms change, the date at the top of this page is updated.
legal.termsGuestDataBody: Without signing in, your progress lives only on this device. Clearing your browser data, or opening the app elsewhere, will not find it. If you want it to last, sign in — everything you have done moves into the account and nothing is lost.
legal.termsIntro: Mufradat is free to use. These terms are short and plain.
legal.termsUseBody: Anyone may use this for learning. Please do not attempt to damage the app, reach other people's data, or send automated bulk requests.
